summary.en: Leave the lander, survey the terrain, map hazards, pick a base site and raise comms.
summary.ar: Leave the lander, survey the terrain, map hazards, pick a base site and raise comms.

briefing.en: Sol 1. Gravity 0.38 g, atmosphere 95% CO2 – your suit is your habitat.
briefing.ar: Sol 1. Gravity 0.38 g, atmosphere 95% CO2 – your suit is your habitat.

briefing.en: Never pick a base site before mapping hazards.
briefing.ar: Never pick a base site before mapping hazards.

briefing.en: Watch the oxygen gauge: EVA burns it far faster than the habitat.
briefing.ar: Watch the oxygen gauge: EVA burns it far faster than the habitat.

hint.en: Cycle the hatch and climb down the ladder.
hint.ar: Cycle the hatch and climb down the ladder.

success_message.en: Boots on regolith. Welcome to Mars.
success_message.ar: Boots on regolith. Welcome to Mars.

hint.en: Walk a 50 m arc and scan the terrain.
hint.ar: Walk a 50 m arc and scan the terrain.

hint.en: Tag boulder fields, soft sand and the crater rim.
hint.ar: Tag boulder fields, soft sand and the crater rim.

success_message.en: Hazard map written to your HUD.
success_message.ar: Hazard map written to your HUD.

hint.en: Lander cargo bay: drill, spectrometer, dosimeter, containers.
hint.ar: Lander cargo bay: drill, spectrometer, dosimeter, containers.

hint.en: Use the dosimeter for a 60-second sample.
hint.ar: Use the dosimeter for a 60-second sample.

objectives.science_note: Curiosity's RAD measured roughly 0.67 mSv/day on the Martian surface – about the order of magnitude used here.

hint.en: Choose a flat, sheltered, resource-close site.
hint.ar: Choose a flat, sheltered, resource-close site.

hint.en: Point it at the orbiter and lock the link.
hint.ar: Point it at the orbiter and lock the link.

hint.en: Anchor the habitat module and start the life-support loop.
hint.ar: Anchor the habitat module and start the life-support loop.

success_message.en: Base online. Mars is now habitable – barely.
success_message.ar: Base online. Mars is now habitable – barely.

message.en: Choosing a site blind risks the entire base. Map the hazards first.
message.ar: Choosing a site blind risks the entire base. Map the hazards first.

message.en: You are not cleared for Mars. Finish Earth Analog training.
message.ar: You are not cleared for Mars. Finish Earth Analog training.

summary.en: Base established. Long-range traverses and crew care are now available.
summary.ar: Base established. Long-range traverses and crew care are now available.

reason.en: Efficient EVA left a healthy oxygen margin.
reason.ar: Efficient EVA left a healthy oxygen margin.

reason.en: Rushed site selection: unstable ground flagged for later stages.
reason.ar: Rushed site selection: unstable ground flagged for later stages.

detail.en: Curiosity's Radiation Assessment Detector measured about 0.67 millisieverts per day on the surface – far above Earth's background, which drives habitat shielding design.
detail.ar: Curiosity's Radiation Assessment Detector measured about 0.67 millisieverts per day on the surface – far above Earth's background, which drives habitat shielding design.

science_notes.source: NASA/JPL – Curiosity RAD results (Hassler et al., Science 2014)

detail.en: Real sites are chosen for engineering safety (slope, rocks, elevation) and science value; Jezero Crater was selected for its ancient river delta.
detail.ar: Real sites are chosen for engineering safety (slope, rocks, elevation) and science value; Jezero Crater was selected for its ancient river delta.

disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Distances, resources and radiation values are simplified.
